title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 per per shitje rrugen e Kosovareve ne Tirane (ID 41212145)
description_sq:
Ne rrugen e Kosovareve, ofrohet per shitje apartament modern 2+1+2, siperfaqe 105 m², kati 3 banim ne nje pallat te ri me 2 ashensor.
Apartamenti organizohet ne: dhome ndenje dhe ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, koridor, ballkon.
I gjithe apartamenti eshte i mobiluar ne menyre moderne, shtruar me parket, kondicioner ne cdo dhome, lavastovilje dhe elektroshtepiake cilesore, tavan gipsi, dritare duroplast dopio xham, ndricim LED.
Aktualisht i dhene me qera ne vleren 1300 euro.
Ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara ne Tirane, me te gjitha fasilitetet e nevojshme afer, shume prane parkut te madh te liqenit.
Shitet 420 000 euro
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale Kosovare street in Tirana (ID 41212145)
description_en: On Kosovareve Street, a modern 2+1+2 apartment is offered for sale, surface area 105 m², 3rd residential floor in a new building with 2 elevators. The apartment is organized in: living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, corridor, balcony. The whole apartment is furnished in a modern way, laid with parquet, air conditioning in every room, dishwasher and quality appliances, plaster ceiling, duroplast double-glazed windows, LED lighting. It is currently rented for 1300 euros. It is located in one of the most preferred areas in Tirana, with all the necessary facilities nearby, very close to the large lake park. For sale, 420,000 euros
